title: HRV Daily Analysis Reference
description: Analysis-reference-only daily condition context from non-running FIT message 370 field 1 scaled by raw/128. It is not source of truth and is not for daily coaching decisions.

disagreeing_fields.description: Starting with v2.0.0: the fields of this row whose values differ between the observations of its stable key, in field order. Those fields are null, and the dataset's audit keeps every observed value. Empty when the observations agree.
